thread:
harper: heads-up  i'm prepping a docs PR that bundles a tiny 'Dedicated -> Private migration' checklist (provisioning pointers, autoscale semantics, isolation decorators, and a short Go SDK reservation example). aiming for tiny, link-forward, and safe to backport. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/724

vic: send branch? i can eyeball terraform and the autoscale examples. also watch for anchor collisions with the capacity handbook.

harper: branch `docs/dedicated/migrate-to-private-compact`. files: ded/migrate-to-private.md, snippets/terraform-dedicated.tf, examples/autoscale-minimal.yml, sdk/go-reserve.md.

jon: quick pass: terraform snippet uses provider without `region` and an older `redwood_dedicated` resource name. suggest `provider "aws" { region = var.region }` and `resource "redwood_dedicated_reservation" { ... }`. autoscale YAML should include `min_replicas` and `cooldown_seconds` in sample to reduce support noise.

vic: noted. also add a short note explaining preemption/eviction behavior on Private (same runtime semantics as Hosted, but with customer-controlled capacity allocation). one-liner: "Private deployments honor platform preemption policies; use tenant-level isolation to reduce eviction surface."

harper: good call. adding: "Private deployments honor preemption; prefer `isolation: tenant` for critical workloads." and a pointer to the runtime isolation doc.

go-sdk-bot: small SDK note: Go example should use the latest API `CreateReservation(ctx, opts)` not `Reserve`. also include a context with timeout and a minimal error switch. proposed snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
defer cancel()
client := dedicated.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
res, err := client.CreateReservation(ctx, dedicated.ReservationOptions{Token: "rsv-xx", Region: "us-west-2"})
if err != nil {
    switch err.(type) {
    case dedicated.ErrAuth:
        fmt.Println("auth failed")
    default:
        fmt.Println("reservation error:", err)
    }
    return
}
fmt.Println(res.ID)
```

harper: perfect, replacing the Go snippet with that. i'll also add a short TS example as a cross-check but keep the focus on Go since a couple of customers asked for it.

jon: anchor collision: found `#autoscale-policy` used in capacity handbook. rename to `#dedicated-migrate-autoscale` and add redirect entry to docs/config/redirects.yaml to avoid 404s. suggested redirect snippet to paste in PR description:
- from: /docs/capacity#autoscale-policy
  to: /docs/dedicated#dedicated-migrate-autoscale

harper: adding the redirect snippet and a comment about anchor naming: "prefix anchors with `ded-` for dedicated docs". avoids future collisions.

legal: SLA phrasing check: keep conservative. suggested line: "Configurable latency SLOs; contractual SLAs are available for Dedicated and Private subscriptions." okay to mention both, but don't use 'guarantee'.

\harper: adopting that exact phrasing. thanks.

link-bot: queued link-check for PR 724 (lc-2026-02-15-09). results will post here.

vic: small docs hygiene: remove inline KMS rotation commands. instead link to KMS integration guide and add one sentence: "If using customer-managed KMS, add a rotation policy to the onboarding ticket." keeps docs non-opinionated.

harper: done. replaced commands with a link and the rotation reminder.
